'''Dionisio Arce''' (14 June 1927 – 5 November 2000) was a Paraguayan [[association football|footballer]] who played as a [[forward (association football)|forward]].<ref>{{Worldfootball.net|dionisio-arce}}</ref> He was known for his ability to handle the ball and heading skills. He started playing for Paraguayan side [[Sportivo Luqueño]] before moving to Italy to play for several teams until the end of his career. He died in 2000, in the city of [[Bracciano]].
